name: Mukhyamantri Bagwani Mission: Aam Vikas Yojana
benefit:
> **Financial Support:** 

    - **First year:** ₹18,000/- per hectare.    - **Second and third year:** ₹6,000/- per hectare.

> **Plant Distribution:** 

    - Supply of high-quality plants.

<br>
_eligibility_text:
1. The applicant should be a resident of Bihar.
   1. The applicant should be a ryot farmer.
   1. The applicant must have agricultural land minimum of 0.25 acres (0.1 ha) and a maximum of 10 acres (4 ha).
   1. The applicant must be registered on the DBT portal.

&amp;amp;gt; **Note 1:  Beneficiary allocation:**

    - General Category: 78.56%.
    - Scheduled Castes: 20%.
    - Scheduled Tribes: 1.44%.
    - Women Participation: 30%.

&amp;amp;gt; **Note 2:** The benefits of this scheme can be taken by ryot farmers on the basis of land documents and non-ryot farmers on the basis of contract form.
